title: Leave Your TRACE with #StagefrightChallenge (#shorts)
description:
Leave Your TRACE with #StagefrightChallenge 

It’s your turn to take the stage!

Show us your creativity using 8TURN’s “Stagefright” sound!

Whether it’s a dance challenge or singing along to “Stagefright,” capture your own Stagefright moment and share it with us!

How to Participate

1. Create your own video.
2. Post it on Instagram or TikTok using the official Stagefright challenge audio clip. *Only videos using the official challenge audio will be eligible.
3. Tag official 8TURN account and include #8TURN #Stagefright #8TURN_Stagefright #StagefrightChallenge

🎁 Three lucky winners will be selected to receive a special gift!

Don’t miss your chance to leave your TRACE!
